cabinets.title: Bridge Buddies
cabinets.manualFocus: Build four bridge spans within your token budget. Test each crossing, learn from the weak spots, and help three carts get across.

cabinets.title: Water Works
cabinets.manualFocus: Rotate the blue pipes to connect the reservoir on the left to the house on the right. Pass through the toy filter in all three networks.

cabinets.title: Harbor Helpers
cabinets.manualFocus: Deliver nine crates to three islands. Your boat holds three crates and has twelve fuel tokens. Check what each island needs before sailing.

cabinets.title: Pantry Picnic
cabinets.manualFocus: Pack three pretend picnic boxes, each with one main and two fruit or vegetable portions. Use the marked leftovers first and finish the pantry.

cabinets.title: Compass Cove
cabinets.manualFocus: Find five treasures by following clues from island landmarks. North is up, east is right, south is down, and west is left on this map.

cabinets.title: Cipher Club
cabinets.manualFocus: Use the toy A–H alphabet and a shared number key to encode or decode five three-letter clubhouse messages. The alphabet wraps around after H.

cabinets.title: Trade Town
cabinets.manualFocus: Fill three shopping requests within their pretend budgets. Compare bundle sizes, unit prices, and delivery fees. You can return items before checkout.

cabinets.title: Critter Council
cabinets.manualFocus: Listen to four neighbors. Place a shaded park, quiet reading hut, step-free ramp, and bench near the park on six plots using twelve builder tokens.
